# oncallalert_integration_key (Resource)

An integration key that lets an external system send alerts to a service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "oncallalert_integration_key" "grafana" {
  service_id = oncallalert_service.api.id
  type       = "grafana"
  name       = "Grafana alerts"
}

# The ingest URL to paste into Grafana's contact point.
output "grafana_webhook_url" {
  value     = oncallalert_integration_key.grafana.href
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `service_id` (String)
- `type` (String) One of `generic`, `grafana`, `site24x7`, `prometheusAlertmanager`, `email`, `universal`.

### Optional

- `external_system_name` (String) Name shown for the sending system.

### Read-Only

- `href` (String, Sensitive) Alert ingest URL (contains the secret key).
- `id` (String) Server-assigned ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import oncallalert_integration_key.example <id>
```
